name: youtube-agent
description: Twelve Claude skills that run a YouTube channel: scripts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, title and thumbnail linted as one pairing, an edit decision list from your transcript, a retention reader that finds the exact moments people leave, a Shorts cutter, chapters, search, comments, the weekly plan, a channel audit, a virality engine ranked by outlier multiple, two fetchers that pull your channel data and transcripts off the YouTube API so you never paste them by hand, and a publish step that uploads the finished video through Blotato.
